script.title: BOOKING A DOG VACCINATION
script.story_hook: Booking the annual vaccination for a dog.
script.intro_zh: 幫狗狗預約一年一度的疫苗。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today we're booking a shot for a dog.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天我們幫狗狗預約疫苗。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep practicing and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續練習，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a laid-back man in his late twenties with short sandy blond hair and a light mustache, wearing a checkered denim shirt and khaki shorts, holding a worn pet folder
script.char_b_description: a cheerful vet tech in her twenties with a high dark ponytail and freckles, wearing sky blue scrubs and small stud earrings, holding a clipboard and smiling
script.youtube_title: 【🐾幫狗約疫苗💉】「需要提前禁食嗎？」獸醫診所實用英文📅聽完就會約｜Dog Vaccination English
script.youtube_title_en: “Book My Dog's Shots” — Booking a Dog Vaccination
script.youtube_description:
狗狗要打疫苗，卻不知道怎麼用英文預約？這段超真實的獸醫診所對話，幫你一次學好！跟著主人從回報狗狗資料、詢問是否禁食、帶疫苗紀錄，到挑選時段與提醒。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口約。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Need to book your dog's shots but unsure how to say it in English? This super-realistic vet clinic chat gets you ready in one listen. Follow the owner sharing pet details, asking about fasting, bringing records, and picking a slot with a reminder — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🐾疫苗預約英文｜回報資料・問是否禁食・挑時段・約提醒｜聽完就會約｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
狗狗該打疫苗，卻不知道怎麼用英文預約？
要不要禁食、帶紀錄、挑時段，該怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進獸醫診所，跟著主人從回報狗狗資料、詢問是否需要禁食，到帶疫苗紀錄、挑選時段與接收提醒，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🐶 回報資料：例如「book my dog's shots」、「his name is Biscuit, he's turning two」。
💉 詢問準備：例如「Does he need to fast beforehand?」、「he can eat normally」。
📅 約時段與提醒：例如「Saturdays fill fast, want one?」、「We'll text a reminder Friday」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來幫狗約疫苗可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a clipboard with a pet folder

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book my dog's shots.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tu bʊk maɪ dɑɡʃ ʃɑts/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想幫我的狗預約打疫苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! What's your dog's name and age?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wɑts jɔr dɑɡʃ neɪm ənd eɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 好！你狗狗的名字和年齡是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His name is Biscuit, he's turning two.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz neɪm ɪz ˈbɪskɪt hiz ˈtɜrnɪŋ tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time for the annual rabies and boosters.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm fɔr ði ˈænjuəl ˈreɪbiz ənd ˈbuːstərz/
dialogue.zh: 該打一年一度的狂犬病和追加劑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. Does he need to fast beforehand?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt dʌz hi nid tu fæst bɪrˈfɔrˈhænd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he can eat normally, that's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hi kæn it ˈnɔrməli ðæts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，他可以吃東西，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. He gets nervous at new places.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd hi ɡɛts ˈnɜrvəs æt nu ˈpleɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好在說。他在陌生場所會緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally normal, we keep things calm here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəli ˈnɔrməl wi kip θɪŋz kɑm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 完全正常，我們這裡保持安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps. Should I bring his records?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ hɪz ˈrɛkərdz/
dialogue.zh: 這樣有幫助。我該帶他的紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his shot book if you have it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪz ʃɑt bʊk ɪf ju hæv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 要的，如果有他的疫苗手冊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do, it's in my glove compartment.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ɪts ɪn maɪ ɡlʌv kəmˈpɑrtmənt/
dialogue.zh: 有，就在我車上的置物匣裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Saturdays fill fast, want one?
dialogue.zh: 很好。週六總是很搶手，要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This Saturday works, what time is open?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈsætərˌdeɪ wɜrks wɑt taɪm ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 這週六可以，還有幾點空著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have two-thirty or three-fifteen left.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tu ˈθɜrdi ɔr θri ˈfɪftin lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 我還有兩點半或三點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's do two-thirty, that suits me best.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts du tu ˈθɜrdi ðæt suts mi bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 就兩點半吧，那個最適合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked. We'll text a reminder Friday.
dialogue.zh: 預約好了。週五我們會發提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, thanks so much for your help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt θæŋks soʊ mʌtʃ fɔr jɔr hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，非常感謝你的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're welcome! Biscuit will do fine.
